# Prefer deterministic adoption levers

Lifecycle status: accepted

Agent-adoption work should prioritize deterministic, shippable startup/tooling fixes before behavioral steering when the deterministic fix helps all users and avoids behavioral guesswork. Evidence: docs/design/agent-codegraph-adoption.md#1 lists verifying/decoupling `serve --mcp` `tools/list` first as highest-value, shippable, broadly helpful, and free of behavioral guesswork, before prototyping the PreToolUse(Read) redirect hook.

Lifecycle status: superseded

CodeGraph should answer MCP `tools/list` locally and instantly from static tool definitions, mark tools exposed, and resolve the daemon in the background for real tool calls. Evidence: docs/design/agent-codegraph-adoption.md#0 ranks this as the biggest shippable P2 win and says to use `getStaticTools` locally rather than waiting on daemon connect if that is the current behavior.

Lifecycle status: accepted

Lifecycle status: superseded

Callback dispatch is handled as a whole-graph pass after base resolution rather than as `FrameworkResolver.resolve()`. Lifecycle status: proposed
